semiconductor_relevance: High — Qingdao Xinnovis specializes in core components essential for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in advanced sensor technologies.
summary: Qingdao Xinnovis Microsystem Technology Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-performance gas mass flow meters/controllers, thin-film vacuum gauges, and pressure controllers for the semiconductor industry. The company leverages advanced research and collaboration with leading institutions to drive innovation in semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Qingdao, China, and has established itself as a National High-tech Enterprise.
